correctness.rationale: For any source and target cycles, equivariant cell invariance forces each color cycle to be unused or placed on one source cycle whose length divides it, with exactly that source length in phase choices. A used target cycle contributes one positive fixed-locus parameter and a used source cycle contributes one normalization, proving dimension t-r. Inclusion–exclusion yields the precise fixed-set Euler Φ. Finite-order Lefschetz agrees with fixed Euler. Babson–Kozlov homology concentration yields the actual top trace; the diagonal S3 class averages plus rational transfer yield its stated top Betti number. All-element finite signed-cell traces agree for five (m,n) pairs; experiments corroborate but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The character determines all joint source and color permutation actions and hence rational invariants for arbitrary symmetry-subgroup quotients, not recoverable from the ordinary sphere rank. The m=3,n=5 comparison of simultaneous versus isolated 3-cycles proves correlated action matters. The diagonal three-source-and-color quotient has the nonzero exact top Betti number (2^n-3+7(-1)^(n-3))/6, which contrasts with the pre-existing full-color rational-acyclic quotient; parameters are all m,n in the coherent graph-coloring family, not ad hoc slices.
